executive_readiness_summary.rule13_trigger_rationale: Observed 4 client-side automation/telemetry signal(s) on razorpay.com (including CRM, CDP, session replay, chat, or ad-tech integrations), which warrant formal documentation under Rule 13(1)-(2) DPIA and algorithmic governance workflows.

priority_readiness_enhancements: Consent & Dark-Pattern Symmetry (Sec 6 / Rules 3-4): Configure a DPDP-aligned Consent Management Platform (CMP) with equal visual prominence for Accept and Reject/Manage buttons, and set `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=Lax/Strict` on all session cookies.

Website Automations, AI & Profiling (Sec 6 / Rule 13(2)): Maintain an internal Website Automation & Tag Governance Register mapping each client-side SDK to its consent category, data retention TTL, and DOM input-masking configuration.

Reasonable Security Safeguards (Sec 8(5) / Rule 6): Configure edge CDN/web server responses to include Strict-Transport-Security (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains), a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, alongside 1-year security log retention (Rule 8(3)).

Cross-Border Sub-Processors (Sec 16 / Rule 15): Maintain a live Sub-Processor & Cross-Border Transfer Register covering all third-party script/CDN domains and verify valid Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) under Section 8(2).
executive_readiness_summary.board_advisory_synopsis: This confidential, read-only passive DPIA readiness assessment of Razorpay (Fintech & Payment Gateway) (https://razorpay.com, Sector: Fintech / Payments) evaluated publicly observable HTTP headers, 6 Set-Cookie header(s), 5 external script(s), and 4 client-side automation signature(s) against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E)). Overall Readiness Score: 87/100 (High Readiness (Aligned)).

advisory_findings.observed_technical_signal: HTTP 200 on https://razorpay.com; 4 privacy/legal notice link(s) detected in DOM (https://razorpay.com/terms/90-day-free-pg-offer/, https://razorpay.com/terms/rsl).
advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 5(1) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 3 (Itemised Notice in clear and plain language)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: The website surfaces 4 accessible privacy/legal notice link(s) in the DOM. To strengthen Rule 3 readiness, ensure the notice presents an itemised inventory of personal data categories and specific processing purposes at every data collection point.
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Ensure every page footer and data collection form includes a prominent, static HTML anchor link to an itemised Section 5 / Rule 3 Privacy Notice with multi-language support (Eighth Schedule languages).
advisory_findings.verification_method: Run a read-only curl/DOM check on the landing page and verify `<a href="/privacy">` is present in the server-rendered HTML.

advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: Initial page load sets 6 cookie(s) and loads 4 client-side telemetry/automation script signature(s) prior to an affirmative consent interaction. While common across modern web architectures, gating non-essential analytics and marketing tags behind an explicit opt-in banner with symmetrical 'Accept' and 'Reject / Manage' controls aligns the user journey with Section 6(1) and Section 6(4).
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Configure a DPDP-aligned Consent Management Platform (CMP) with equal visual prominence for Accept and Reject/Manage buttons, and set `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, and `SameSite=Lax/Strict` on all session cookies.
advisory_findings.verification_method: Inspect initial HTTP `Set-Cookie` headers and network requests in a clean browser profile before interacting with the consent banner.
